items.title: LA school district blocks Google's AI search features, per Engadget
items.description: Engadget reports that an LA school district has blocked Google's AI search features, while the company has insisted that AI overviews and search are a package deal.

items.title: FT asks whether AI can crack encryption, citing data-leak risks in banking and commerce
items.description: The Financial Times excerpt says new models' advancing capabilities raise concerns over data-leak risks in banking and commerce, under the title 'Can AI crack encryption?'. No specific models, results or methods are given in the snippet.

items.title: AI shopping agents gain momentum but face retailer roadblocks
items.description: CNBC reports that AI shopping agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise to help users shop, but are hitting roadblocks as Amazon and a growing number of sites block or restrict them.

items.title: L.A. school officials block Google's AI features on school-issued devices
items.description: Fast Company reports that Los Angeles Unified School District has disabled Google's AI Overview summaries in searches on school devices, and districts may drop Google products unless a permanent AI workaround is offered.

items.title: LinkedIn post says ontologies and knowledge graphs ground AI but need visual approaches
items.description: A LinkedIn post by Emanuele Laurenzi states that ontologies and knowledge graphs provide grounding but cannot remain the exclusive domain of ontology engineers, pointing to visual approaches. The snippet is short and does not describe a specific method or evaluation.

items.title: LinkedIn post shares a recording of a monthly chat with Shane Gibson on ontologies and semantics.
items.description: The LinkedIn post by Juha Korpela announces a watchable recording of a monthly chat with Shane Gibson, described as covering ontologies, semantics, and the semantics of ontologies. The excerpt is promotional and offers no further detail on the discussion content.

items.title: The Register: Birmingham's Oracle debacle bill reaches £128M
items.description: The Register reports the cost of Birmingham's delayed Oracle implementation, a replacement for SAP that the outlet says helped bankrupt the city, has reached £128M, with the true cost possibly much higher.

items.title: Apache Data Lakehouse weekly covers cardinality proposals, compliance suites and 0.3.0 release
items.description: The LinkedIn Pulse roundup describes proposals on explicit relationship cardinality, a period-keyed join returning a wrong result, and merged PR #803 bringing composable query interfaces with compliance suites. It notes a suggestion to include the work in a coming 0.3.0-incubating release.

items.title: IEEE Spectrum profiles an emergency physician who became Boston Children's Hospital's first clinical AI engineer
items.description: IEEE Spectrum profiles Dinesh Rai, an emergency physician with a clinical informatics fellowship who took a 2023 prompt engineer role at Boston Children's Hospital and became its first clinical AI engineer. The piece describes his unusual path combining medicine and self-taught coding.

items.title: FT argues Delaware's proposed law would gut human accountability for agentic AI
items.description: The Financial Times reports on a Delaware proposed law that, per the outlet, would gut human accountability for agentic AI companies, calling it a dangerous plan.

items.title: Europe's AI sovereignty push: cloud spending booms but models and chips stay abroad
items.description: The Register examines Europe's AI sovereignty push, arguing that while datacenter spending is booming, the models, chips, and clout largely remain in the US and Asia.

items.title: LinkedIn essay asks whether AI adoption has changed how organisations think
items.description: The LinkedIn Pulse excerpt describes generic AI capabilities: machine learning identifying patterns at scale, NLP extracting signal from unstructured text, predictive modelling extending decision horizons, and graph analytics revealing relational structures. It frames these as ways AI could reshape organisational infrastructure.

items.title: Hard Fork podcast explores how AI is transforming mathematics
items.description: The New York Times' Hard Fork podcast episode covers how AI is transforming mathematics, quoting Terence Tao: "One thing that A.I. has done is that it's given us answers without insight, without understanding."

items.title: Guardian reports first UK purchase by an AI agent using cardless payment in FCA sandbox trial
items.description: The Guardian reports that a Papa John's order became the first UK purchase made by an AI agent using cardless payment technology, tested in the FCA's regulated sandbox with Lloyds Bank and TrueLayer.

items.title: LinkedIn post promotes a Power BI technique for faster semantic models using run-length encoding.
items.description: The LinkedIn post by dotykier promotes guidance for improving performance in large Power BI semantic models using run-length encoding. The excerpt is promotional and does not detail the technique's implementation or measured results.
